items.text: Today we did a big overhaul of the booth. We added new shelving that gives us more space for new products, did some restocking, and added some new items. Check out new magnets and pins, build your own bookmarks, and enjoy the updated booth!
Today we are adding even more of your favorite dog magnets in a new easy-to-use carousel. Stop by and find your dog, and be on the lookout for more products coming soon!
